meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 装好后，你把一篇文章、一段笔记或一个话题文字交给它，它会把文字变成“无真人出镜”的讲解视频。画面没有实拍素材，每一幕都用排版、抽象图形、图表等按场景现编；它会按固定步骤产出脚本、音频并渲染成 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当你给一段纯文字，想做概念解释、教程或清单盘点类视频时触发；不处理基于网站/产品页的短片（那是别的流程），意图不明确时会先转通用入口再判断。

say.text: 请把这篇文章做成一个3分钟的无脸讲解视频。
say.note: 会先确认流程，再开始设计分镜与生成画面。

say.text: 帮我科普“复利”这个概念，做一段带图的短视频。
say.note: 会基于该文本创建项目并走完整制作流程。

say.text: 把这份笔记转成带图表的知识点讲解片。
say.note: 会按步骤产出设计、脚本并渲染视频。

howto.what_en: Once installed, give it an article or notes and it makes a faceless explainer video: scenery is invented via typography, abstract graphics, charts, etc. It follows a fixed pipeline ending in script, audio, and an mp4 render.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply raw text for a concept explainer, tutorial, or listicle video. Not for website-based promos; unclear cases route to the general flow.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a 3-minute faceless explainer.
say_en.note: It checks versions, then starts project setup.

say_en.text: Explain compound interest as a short video with graphics.
say_en.note: It creates the storyboard, script, and renders.

say_en.text: Turn these notes into an explainer with data charts.
say_en.note: Uses the text as source and runs the pipeline.
